title: WFP2-BANK: square-log weighted Fourier search with linear classical storage

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE WFP2-BANK physical implementation in proof.md executes the complete current WFP2 logical algorithm selected by profile-source.md and its four included complete mathematical helpers. Its measured basis-bank/active-word/native-controller construction is proved for the exact original fixed joint-good-marginal input, including arbitrary malformed/good/reference correlations and passive unread source systems. The full CQ invariant and actual gate-word equality preserve V output law exactly, so whole-secret success is STRICTLY greater than2/3, including clean inputs and the same noisy-input finite branch. All large virtual classical arrays, frequency/angle records, metadata and long scratch occupy counted basis-state quantum cells. A constant number of active n-bit words and 8-bit-per-level preparation return frames remain physically classical. Repeated attempts and the NEW flagged Fourier base use native persistent known-address descriptors; coefficient/frequency rows are read at CLASSICAL loop indices, never at a measured or coherent query address. Slow polynomial scanning interpretation is confined to polynomial-total large-branch phases and the fixed public finite prefix, whose absolute-constant absorption is proved separately. EVERY cost is counted on EVERY branch, including all source calls/SWAPs, actual bit/gate generation, full addresses, padding/inactive fields, failed attempts/guards, initialization/mode transfer and complete output-first cleanup. No QRAM, free word operation, source inverse/control, supplied purification, instruction oracle or arbitrary rotation primitive is used. ALL FIVE guarantees concern this SAME implementation. Actual charged time is O(2^((1/2)n)n(log2n)^2), exact growth index1. Native sampled constraints and the FULL flagged Fourier base/inverse each cost O(nL^3), including all measured-array reads and address/descriptor work. The constant-size frame generator gives the same charged three-call recurrence. Native clock/token/verification work fits C B A_j nL^3 per pre-debited attempt, so the original hard square-log token budget O(2^(n/2)/L) proves EVERY-BRANCH time. All generic phases have polynomial TOTAL work on the large branch; generic finite-prefix overhead is bounded by a fixed absolute constant.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
